_doc: Generated by game/tools/sprite_pipeline.gd (FLEET_PACK.md T-016). Schema: id, name, tbd, world_height (DESIGN.md section 5 body-size table, SR-2; null where the section gives the enemy no row), animations[] {name, fps, loop, frames[] (paths relative to this folder), body_rect[] (tight bbox of alpha > 16 per frame, the HITBOXES shape), world_height per animation/frame where it differs}, sources[] = the ENEMIES.md 'Attachment mapping' state. Resourced at res://content/enemies/<id>/sprites.json.
name: kiwi cat

anim._doc: T-083. Spec: research/fable-tickets.md section 1.1 (the 1.x tables are the spec; ENEMIES.md behavior sentences are frozen per D-040). One entry per table row, keyed by a snake_case state id; 'row' repeats the exact table row label. spec_frames are the section 1.1 frame names in table order; frames are the files that exist on disk, relative to this folder (the art is real as of T-ART-KIWI_CAT: spawn/idle_chase/telegraph are distinct frames derived from assets_src/enemies/kiwicat.png by game/tools/art/kiwi_cat.gd; see frame_map and DECISIONS D-T083-1/D-T083-2 and D-ART-KIWI_CAT-1..4). Timings are in 60 Hz ticks; the sim drives frame = table lookup from ticks_in_state (section 1.0), never a wall clock; the attack frame lands on the tick its kill resolves. Effects are shader/transform effects on the billboard and never change body_rect. Timings are binding; frame art is not. frame_map keeps the spec's single kiwicat_00 mapped to sprites/cycle_00.png (all visual states share that one spec frame name, so the map can only hold one target); the per-state files are listed in states[*].frames and in the top-level animations[].

telegraph.repeat_when: while within 14 u of the player

params.note: scale pulse 1.0 -> 1.12 -> 1.0 over the 12 ticks; every 180 ticks (3.0 s, binding) while within 14 u
params.zoomies: Zoomies (curse): the double meow = two pulses 12 ticks apart, then a red outline for the 180-tick sprint

params.note: contact kills on the tick the hit cylinders overlap; the cat has no wind-up - its tell is its presence
